cases.name: sum-entity-matches
cases.description: a flat entity whose Schema and Node were authored in lockstep matches

cases.name: arithmetic-entity-matches
cases.description: a oneOf entity whose Schema and Node were authored in lockstep matches

cases.name: missing-property-rejects
cases.description: a Schema missing a property Node declares rejects, naming both sides

cases.name: shorter-required-list-rejects
cases.description: a Schema whose required list omits an entry Node requires rejects

cases.name: out-of-scope-keyword-rejects
cases.description: a correctly-authored pattern-properties pair rejects, since patternProperties is outside this check's scope

cases.name: redundant-type-with-enum-matches
cases.description: a `type` sibling fully implied by every `enum` member's JSON type matches

cases.name: redundant-type-with-const-matches
cases.description: a `type` sibling fully implied by `const`'s JSON type matches

cases.name: nullable-type-array-matches
cases.description: a nullable `type: [T, 'null']` schema matches its equivalent `anyOf` Node

cases.name: empty-properties-matches
cases.description: an empty `properties: {}` and an absent `properties` key match

cases.name: open-additional-properties-matches
cases.description: an explicit `additionalProperties: true`/`{}` and an absent `additionalProperties` key match

cases.name: annotation-drift-matches
cases.description: differing annotation-only keywords (`description`, `title`) never block a match

cases.name: mixed-type-enum-rejects
cases.description: a mixed-type `enum` keeps its `type` sibling — dropping it would accept an instance the enum itself already narrows

cases.name: genuine-type-mismatch-rejects
cases.description: a `type` genuinely inconsistent with its `enum` members still rejects

cases.name: genuine-additional-properties-mismatch-rejects
cases.description: a Node that forbids additional properties against a Schema that allows them still rejects
